native.cpu_topology:
# The following is the parsable format, which can be fed to other
# programs. Each different item in every column has an unique ID
# starting usually from zero.
# CPU,Core,Socket
0,0,0
1,1,0
2,2,0
3,3,0
4,4,0
native.metric: Established-connection whole-operation latency; setup/handshake excluded, validation and cleanup included.
native.order: Rotate variants then reverse every complete cycle; five repetitions do not exactly balance positions.
